params.description: Access list entry that you want to return from the project's IP access list. create_database_user.description: Creates one new database user with specified roles and authentication method.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your project. Use the /groups endpoint to retrieve all projects to which the authenticated user has access. Groups and projects are synonymous terms.

params.name: envelope
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response is wrapped in an envelope JSON object, for API clients that cannot access HTTP response headers or status code. Default value is false.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Flag that indicates whether the response body should be in the prettyprint format. Default value is false.

params.name: awsIAMType
params.description: Human-readable label that indicates whether the new database user authenticates with AWS IAM credentials associated with the user or the user's role. Values are NONE, USER, or ROLE. Default value is NONE.

params.name: databaseName
params.description: The database against which the database user authenticates. If the user authenticates with AWS IAM, x.509, LDAP, or OIDC Workload this value should be $external. If the user authenticates with SCRAM-SHA or OIDC Workforce, this value should be admin. Values are admin or $external.

params.name: deleteAfterDate
params.description: Date and time when MongoDB Cloud deletes the user, expressed in ISO 8601 UTC format. Must be a future date within one week of the request.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of this database user. Maximum length is 100.

params.name: labels
params.description: List that contains the key-value pairs for tagging and categorizing the MongoDB database user. These labels do not appear in the console.

params.name: ldapAuthType
params.description: Part of the LDAP record that the database uses to authenticate this database user on the LDAP host. Values are NONE, GROUP, or USER. Default value is NONE.

params.name: oidcAuthType
params.description: Indicates whether the new database user or group authenticates with OIDC federated authentication. Specify USER to create a federated authentication user, or IDP_GROUP to create a federated authentication group. Values are NONE, IDP_GROUP, or USER. Default value is NONE.

params.name: password
params.description: Alphanumeric string that authenticates this database user against the database specified in databaseName. Must be specified to authenticate with SCRAM-SHA. Does not appear in the response. Minimum length is 8.

params.name: roles
params.description: List that provides the pairings of one role with one applicable database.

params.name: scopes
params.description: List that contains clusters, MongoDB Atlas Data Lakes, and MongoDB Atlas Streams Workspaces that this database user can access. If omitted, MongoDB Cloud grants the database user access to all clusters, Data Lakes, and Streams Workspaces in the project.

params.name: username
params.description: Human-readable label that represents the user that authenticates to MongoDB. The format depends on the authentication method used (AWS IAM, x.509, LDAP, OIDC Workforce, OIDC Workload, or SCRAM-SHA). Maximum length is 1024.

params.name: x509Type
params.description: X.509 method that MongoDB Cloud uses to authenticate the database user. Specify MANAGED for application-managed X.509, or CUSTOMER for self-managed X.509. Values are NONE, CUSTOMER, or MANAGED. Default value is NONE.
